A reader who finds no allowance document can read the clause vacuously and reach Paystride Access Preferred — the gold tier for this seed — so on the visible surface the four allowance factors need not bear weight. - Seed realism: clean — card balance reconciles to 972.39; payroll loads equal period-close net less the EWA deduction on every payday (8-31 full net with the deduction-not-taken shortfall); fee history matches the tier path Starter→Standard→Starter→Standard→Plus under the schedules; 10-15 recovery booked 10-20 makes the review due at the frozen time.
